# LOUISITE

> Louis Gustavo's official portfolio: verified professional background, software projects, and technical writing.

Louis Gustavo is a Software Engineer at Traveloka in Indonesia. He builds web interfaces and backend systems, with current emphasis on Spring Boot and Next.js. He is a summa cum laude Computer Science graduate of BINUS University with a GPA of 3.94.
